story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. API key validation: Show specific error if key is invalid/missing 2. Timeline validation: Show error if no audio/video clips exist before transcription 3. Whisper API errors: Display user-friendly messages (audio too large, quota exceeded) 4. GPT-4o-mini API errors: Display rate limit warnings, network failures 5. Empty input validation: Warn if trying to generate with no transcription or guidance 6. Platform limit warnings: Clear visual indicators when exceeding character limits 7. Network error handling: Retry logic with user notification 8. Loading states: Disable buttons during processing to prevent duplicate requests 9. Error messages use shadcn/ui Alert/Toast components 10. All error states allow user to retry or return to previous step

docs.doc: Comprehensive error handling strategy for API failures, validation errors, and network issues with user-friendly messages and retry logic.

story-context.constraints: - Error Categorization: Classify by type (auth, network, quota, validation) for appropriate handling - User-Friendly Messages: Translate technical errors to actionable messages with suggestions - Retry Logic: Exponential backoff (max 2 retries) for transient errors (network, rate limits), no retry for auth failures - Loading States: Disable buttons during operations to prevent race conditions - Validation: Timeline (has clips), API key (valid), inputs (transcription or guidance), platforms (at least one) - Character Limits: Twitter 280, LinkedIn 3000, YouTube no limit - Error Display: shadcn/ui Alert for inline errors, Toast for notifications - Error Logging: Console logs with [AI-Error] prefix, context, timestamp

interfaces.interface: Displays error notification using shadcn/ui Toast
Displays inline error alert with optional retry action

tests.standards: Unit tests for error message display, retry logic, validation. Integration tests for API error scenarios with mocked responses. Test all error types: auth, network, quota, validation.
tests.ideas: - AC 1: Test API key validation with invalid/missing key - AC 2: Test timeline validation (no clips → error) - AC 3: Test Whisper errors (file too large, quota exceeded, network failure) - AC 4: Test GPT errors (rate limit, quota, network, stream interruption) - AC 5: Test input validation (no transcription and no guidance → error) - AC 6: Test character limit warnings (Twitter >280, LinkedIn >3000) - AC 7: Test retry logic (max 2 retries, exponential backoff, transient vs permanent errors) - AC 8: Test loading states (buttons disabled during operations) - AC 9: Test error display with Alert/Toast components - AC 10: Test retry buttons and "Back" options
